intro: This section looks at temperament -- the general disposition suggested by your Lagna (Ascendant) and its ruling planet. This is v1 scope: it covers Lagna-sign temperament only, not the Moon or nakshatra-based temperament some readers may see in fuller treatments elsewhere.
closingNote: Temperament describes a leaning, not a fixed script -- free will operates within it, the same as with any other placement in this chart. A strength here is worth drawing on deliberately; a blind spot is worth attention, not worry.
